notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Cash income taxes paid are not disclosed in the FY2025 10-K: the cash-flow statement has no supplemental tax line, the income-tax note (adopted ASU 2023-09 prospectively) gives no taxes-paid table, and companyfacts has no FY2025 IncomeTaxesPaidNet fact; the 10-K's 'taxes paid' lines are withholding taxes on RSU net settlement, which are not income taxes. So taxes is null.
